name: Hydra Skin Cloak
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 13th; Slot shoulders; Price 6,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This leather cloak is made of gray-brown, dark brown, or tan reptilian hide. Five times per day, as a free action once per round, the wearer can activate the cloak to heal himself 5 points of damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, regenerate; Cost 3,000 gp.

or

Craft (leatherworking) 5 ranks, one hydra skin; DC 23; Cost 0 gp.
